# pcre2test full-format fixture
# Tests multi-delimiter, continuations, modifier lists, # commands

# Simple /…/ pattern
/abc/
    abc

# Pattern with flags
/[a-z]+/i
    XYZ

# Non-slash delimiter (!)
!foo|bar!
    foobar

# Non-slash delimiter (#) — different from comment
#hello#
    hello

# Modifier list (comma-separated)
/case_test/caseless,multiline
    CASE_TEST

# Multi-line continuation (delimiter not closed on first line)
/multi
line
pattern/i
    multilinepattern

# Command line (skip, don't crash)
#pattern
#perltest
#subject anything here

# Empty pattern (should be skipped)
//
    empty

# Escaped delimiter
/foo\/bar/
    foo/bar

# Pattern with many flags
/\d+/imsx
    123

# Backslash at end of pattern (not a continuation — delimiter follows)
/end\\/
    end\

# Pattern with non-standard delimiter and flags
<anchored><
    anchored
